blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: You will open a flimsy brown door.
exercises.why: **открыть → откроешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Здесь ___ (разносить) почту два раза в день.
exercises.prompt: Mail delivery here is twice a day.
exercises.why: **разносить → разносят** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Her beauty will fade in time.
exercises.why: **поблёкнуть → поблекнет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: А какую раскладку клавиатуры ты ___ (использовать): ЙЦУКЕН или Дворака?
exercises.prompt: Which keyboard layout do you use: QWERTY or Dvorak?
exercises.why: **использовать → используешь** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You will nip it in the bud.
exercises.why: **подавить → подавишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Это довольно просто, если ___ (сообразить), в чём фишка.
exercises.prompt: It's easy enough once you figure out the trick.
exercises.why: **сообразить → сообразишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I won't breathe a word.
exercises.why: **проронить → пророню** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Will you stamp this letter for me?
exercises.why: **поставить → поставишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's make it three o'clock.
exercises.why: **условиться → условимся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Сегодня мы ___ (провести) эксперимент на работу закона Ома.
exercises.prompt: Today we will carry out an experiment about Ohm's Law.
exercises.why: **провести → проведём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Эта балка не ___ (выдержать) веса второго яруса.
exercises.prompt: This beam won't hold the weight of the second story.
exercises.why: **выдержать → выдержит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: The lilies of the valley will flower soon.
exercises.why: **зацвести → зацветут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm getting the hell outta here.
exercises.why: **уходить → ухожу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Если не складывать одежду или не вешать её, она ___ (помяться).
exercises.prompt: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
exercises.why: **помяться → помнётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: One day, Europe will speak Breton.
exercises.why: **заговорить → заговорит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You look healthy.
exercises.why: **выглядеть → выглядишь** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Wait until the meal gets cold.
exercises.why: **остыть → остынет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: We'll need shelter.
exercises.why: **понадобиться → понадобится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll stand guard now. Go get some sleep.
exercises.why: **подежурить → подежурю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: The doctor is examining the patients.
exercises.why: **обследовать → обследует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
